Emma Ruth Rundle, Sadness and Trhä announced for Roadburn 2027

August 18, 2026

After the incredible response to last week’s Neurosis announcement, we couldn’t wait to share a little more of what we’re building for Roadburn 2027.

Joining the line-up are three very special additions:

  • Emma Ruth Rundle, returning to Tilburg for a full performance of her forthcoming album These Killing Times;
  • Sadness and Trhä, two projects rooted in black metal from cult underground artist Damián Ojeda, both making their European live debuts.
    Three artists, three very different worlds that we are bringing together through Roadburn 2027

Consider this another glimpse of where we’re heading.
